_note: PicklistSchema (`data/picklist.zod.ts`) — a shared option list that select fields reference by name (`Field.select({ picklist })`). Seeded 2026-09-30 with the spec layer (#19518), every key `planned`: the kind is registered ahead of its runtime reader by ruling (spec layer first, runtime layer #19519 Blocked-by it). The ADR-0010 envelope keys carry the same `null` verdict as `capability`: loader-stamped, not authored.

name.note: The handle a field's `picklist` names. Declared with the spec layer of the picklist kind (#19518); its runtime reader is the runtime layer (#19519: load before `object`, additive merge of `picklistExtensions`, resolve onto the served field, write validation against the resolved set), which has NOT landed. No code outside `packages/spec` reads a picklist yet, so this is `planned`, not `live`. Re-verify to `live` against #19519's resolver.
